headword: {不法|ふほう}{侵入|しんにゅう}

definitions.explanation: The act of entering someone's property, building, or territory without permission or legal right. A legal term commonly seen in news reports.

examples.japanese: {不法|ふほう}{侵入|しんにゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。

⟦{敷地|しきち}→敷地：00365_shikichi⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{不法|ふほう}{侵入|しんにゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦カメラ→カメラ：04417_kamera⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設置|せっち}した→設置する：26989_secchisuru⟧。
examples.english: Cameras were installed to prevent trespassing on the property.

examples.japanese: ⟦{深夜|しんや}→深夜：00368_shinya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{不法|ふほう}{侵入|しんにゅう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{疑|うたが}い→疑い：09757_utagai⟧で、⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{取|と}り{調|しら}べ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けている→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: A man is being questioned on suspicion of illegally entering a school late at night.

notes:
USAGE:
A legal and news term. In Japanese criminal law, this corresponds to ⟦{住居|じゅうきょ}→住居：11612_juukyo⟧⟦{侵入|しんにゅう}→侵入：11440_shinnyuu⟧{罪|ざい} (crime of trespass). Frequently seen in news reports about break-ins and unauthorized entry.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不法|ふほう}{侵入|しんにゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to trespass)
- {不法|ふほう}{侵入|しんにゅう}{者|しゃ} (trespasser)
- {不法|ふほう}{侵入|しんにゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{疑|うたが}い→疑い：09757_utagai⟧ (suspicion of trespassing)
- {不法|ふほう}{侵入|しんにゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}される→逮捕する：26830_taihosuru⟧ (to be arrested for trespassing)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{侵入|しんにゅう}→侵入：11440_shinnyuu⟧: intrusion, entry — neutral, can be legal or illegal
- {不法|ふほう}{侵入|しんにゅう}: specifically illegal entry
